title: Nextera DNA Flex NGS Library Prep: Amplify Tagmented DNA
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required hardware
steps.instruction: Collect all consumables and equipment listed: Opentrons magnetic module, Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well low‑profile PCR plate (200 µL, catalog #hsp9601), Agilent single‑channel reservoir (290 mL, catalog #201252‑100), Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack with 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, P50 single‑channel electronic pipette, P300 single/multi‑channel electronic pipette, and 300 µL Opentrons tip racks.

steps.title: Preprogram thermocycler
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the BLT PCR program parameters as described in the Nextera DNA Flex kit manual.

steps.title: Load tuberack on temperature module
steps.instruction: Place a 4 × 6 aluminum block tuberack in slot 4 of the OT‑2, mounted on the temperature module, and load the following tubes:

substeps.instruction: Mastermix: 1.5 mL snap‑cap tubes in wells A1‑C1 (load one empty tube per 32 samples).
EPM: 0.5 mL false‑bottom tubes in wells A2‑D2 (load one tube per 24 samples).
Nuclease‑free water: 1.5 mL snap‑cap tubes in wells A3‑B3 (load one tube per 48 samples).

steps.title: Enter pipette mounts and sample count
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, specify the mount side (left/right) for the P50 and P300 pipettes and input the total number of samples to be processed.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the Python protocol file for the Amplify Tagmented DNA step to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing tip racks, the reservoir, the tuberack, the magnetic module, and any other required labware in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App to calibrate the tip racks, all labware, and both pipettes. Follow the support articles if needed.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the Opentrons App to begin the Amplify Tagmented DNA protocol.
